notes: Account summary: NovaFabric builds low-latency personalization and bidding features for large publishers (adtech). Heavy emphasis on 5–20ms p50 for short chat/rerank flows and also batch embedding generation for nightly re-ranks. They have strong data residency and KMS requirements; want VPC/private control plane. sla_requirements: Latency SLOs: p50 < 10ms, p95 < 40ms for real-time rerank path; throughput guarantee during auction windows: sustained 5k TPS per region with 2x burst headroom. Required SLA: financial credits for >99.9% uptime on dedicated pool and >99% compliance with p95 latency SLO measured at route level. Data residency: EU/NA split by customer domain; audit logging retention 1 year.
cost_model_summary: Objective: produce deterministic unit economics for a 12-month reserved GPU commit. Assumptions used below are from PoC synthetic runs and public instance pricing (customer asked to model H100-equivalent performance). 1) Baseline commit candidate buckets: 4 H100-eq, 8 H100-eq, 16 H100-eq. 2) Hourly fully-burdened infra cost (amortized HW, rack, power, maint, Redwood support margin): assumed $10/hr per H100-eq (enterprise reserved pricing, net). 3) Hours/month: 24 * 30 = 720. Monthly reserved cost per GPU = $7,200. 4) Utilization scenarios: conservative 50% effective utilization (conservative for strict latency SLO with reserved headroom), target 70% utilization (with batching & caching improvements), optimistic 90% utilization (steady-state, high cache hit). 5) Token throughput per GPU (observed in PoC): baseline mix => 65M tokens/day per H100-eq at 60% utilization; equivalently ~45 tokens/sec average. 6) Monthly tokens per GPU (60% util) ~1.95B tokens. 7) Unit compute cost per token = monthly cost per GPU / monthly tokens = $7,200 / 1.95e9 = ~$0.00000369 per token (60% util). 8) At 70% util (2.275B tokens/mo) unit cost ≈ $0.00000317/token. At 90% util ≈ $0.00000253/token. 9) Network, storage, and license add-ons: +10–18% on top of compute unit cost depending on VPC egress and KMS HSM fees. 10) Effective blended unit price guidance to present to procurement: $0.0000035/token (conservative; includes 10% overhead) for 8 GPU commit at 12-month term. 11) Break-even bucket advice: If NovaFabric expects monthly tokens >12B, 8 GPUs at 70% util is efficient; below ~5B tokens/mo, smaller commit (4 GPUs) or flexible burst makes more sense. 12) SLA tradeoffs: enforcing tight p95 targets requires lower utilization headroom; model this as a 10–20% uplift to reserved capacity (i.e., plan +20% GPUs to preserve tail SLOs) which increases unit cost proportionally. 13) Negotiation levers for AE/Finance: longer commit term (24–36 months) to push $/hr down, commit+burst pricing (base reserved at high utilization + discounted burst hours), quantization model tiers, and volume tiers for embedding vs generation. 14) Recommended next step: run 1-week stratified traffic PoC to refine tokens/GPU/day for their exact model mix (3 model variants: small embedding, medium chat, large rerank).
final_recommendation: Recommend an initial 8 H100-equivalent reserved commit (12-month) with a 2x burst allowance and explicit p95/p99 measurement hooks in SLA. Price proactively at $0.0000035/token (conservative) with room to lower to $0.0000026/token at 90% util + 12-month prepay, and include an SLA appendix for tail credits. Pilot to confirm real-world token/sec and update final pricing before procurement approval.
